review_rules: Khajiiti origin stories and lunar theology remain attributed traditions unless independently evidenced
Furstock descriptions must retain source/era because terminology and presentation vary across games
Khunzar-ri legends should separate legendary narrative from observed ESO-era evidence
Dragon claims should distinguish individual testimony, historical record and directly observed quest events
Cross-link existing Khajiit, Elsweyr, Alkosh, Azurah, Lunar Lattice, Mane, Dro-m'Athra, Sai Sahan and Abnur Tharn subjects
Do not collapse Anequina/Pellitine geographic, political and historical meanings into one undifferentiated record
